# A page wider than the window

The code block below does not wrap, so the page is wider than the window
and the view scrolls sideways. The recents page must not inherit that
scroll position.

```text
srl-systemlandskab: rekrutteringssystem -> jobopslag -> ansogning -> samtale -> tilbud -> kontrakt -> onboarding (this line is deliberately long so the page scrolls sideways)
second line, also long: rekrutteringssystem / jobopslag / ansogning / samtale / tilbud / kontrakt / onboarding / offboarding / arkiv (again long enough to overflow the column)
```
